name: Compliantish
author: Harris Kenny
description: Local workstation checks for Omarchy — yes, the name is the joke. Disk encryption, screen lock, antivirus, password manager, automatic updates. Unofficial Vanta/Drata-inspired compliance desk; not affiliated. No vendor API.

barWidget.description: Local workstation checks (the name is the joke): disk encryption, screen lock, antivirus, password manager, automatic updates. Unofficial; not affiliated with Drata or Vanta.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to re-run the local probe script (default 900 = 15 minutes). Drata's official agent syncs roughly daily; this interval is a local re-probe only. Probes are read-only and offline.

schema.label: Screen lock max idle (seconds)
schema.description: Screen lock passes when idle→lock timeout is configured and ≤ this value. Default 900 = 15 minutes (Drata Test 61). Vanta allows up to 60 minutes — raise this knob if you only need Vanta parity.

schema.label: Notify on new fail
schema.description: Opt-in desktop toast (notify-send) once per check per day when an enabled check transitions to fail. Off by default.

schema.label: Check hard drive encryption
schema.description: Include hard drive encryption in the panel and bar pass count. Primary toggle: panel Checks menu (widget settings still work). On by default.

schema.label: Check screen lock
schema.description: Include screen lock in the panel and bar pass count. Primary toggle: panel Checks menu (widget settings still work). On by default.

schema.label: Check antivirus
schema.description: Include antivirus in the panel and bar pass count. Primary toggle: panel Checks menu (widget settings still work). On by default — turn off in Checks if Omarchy has no AV.

schema.label: Check password manager
schema.description: Include password manager in the panel and bar pass count. Primary toggle: panel Checks menu (widget settings still work). On by default.

schema.label: Check automatic updates
schema.description: Include automatic updates in the panel and bar pass count (Drata agent light; not a first-class Vanta Device Monitor column). Primary toggle: panel Checks menu (widget settings still work). On by default — turn off in Checks if policy is manual.
